<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I've received a message from Brad. He has checked the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor and found that none of the times I proposed work. He has provided me with a list of their available slots.

My next step is to compare the list of available slots from Brad with the calendars of Priya Raman and Marcus Hale to see if there are any matches.

Brad's proposed slots:
*   Mon: 11:00, 11:30
*   Tue: 09:00, 09:30
*   Wed: 13:00, 13:30
*   Thu: 09:30, 15:00

My partners' availability (from my previous analysis):
*   Priya Raman:
    *   Mon: 09:00-10:00, 13:00-14:00
    *   Tue: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:30-17:00
    *   Wed: 12:30-13:00, 15:00-16:00
    *   Thu: 09:00-09:30, 10:00-10:30, 13:00-13:30, 14:30-15:00
    *   Fri: 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30, 14:00-14:30
*   Marcus Hale:
    *   Mon: 09:00-10:00, 11:00-11:30, 15:00-15:30
    *   Tue: 11:00-11:30, 13:00-14:00, 15:30-16:00
    *   Wed: 09:00-09:30, 12:00-12:30, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:00
    *   Thu: 10:00-10:30, 12:00-12:30, 14:30-15:00
    *   Fri: 11:00-12:00, 14:30-15:00

Let's check for overlaps:
*   Mon 11:00: Priya is busy.
*   Mon 11:30: Priya and Marcus are both busy.
*   Tue 09:00: Priya is busy.
*   Tue 09:30: Priya is busy.
*   Wed 13:00: Priya is busy.
*   Wed 13:30: Priya is busy.
*   Thu 09:30: Priya is busy.
*   Thu 15:00: Marcus is busy.

It seems there are no available slots at all when comparing the two lists. This means there is no time for the meeting next week. I need to report this as infeasible.

However, before I do that, I should double check my initial analysis of my partners' free times.

My previous analysis of free slots for Priya and Marcus:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00, 14:30
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Brad's proposed slots:
Mon: 11:00, 11:30
Tue: 09:00, 09:30
Wed: 13:00, 13:30
Thu: 09:30, 15:00

Let's re-examine the calendars.

Priya's Calendar:
Mon: Busy from 10:00-13:00, 14:00-17:00. Free: 9:00-10:00, 13:00-14:00.
Tue: Busy from 9:00-10:30, 11:00-13:00, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:30. Free: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:30-17:00.
Wed: Busy from 9:00-12:30, 13:00-15:00, 16:00-17:00. Free: 12:30-13:00, 15:00-16:00.
Thu: Busy from 9:30-10:00, 10:30-17:00. Free: 9:00-9:30, 10:00-10:30.
Fri: Busy from 9:00-11:00, 12:00-13:00, 13:30-17:00. Free: 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30.

Marcus's Calendar:
Mon: Busy from 10:00-11:00, 11:30-17:00. Free: 9:00-10:00, 11:00-11:30.
Tue: Busy from 9:00-11:00, 11:30-13:00, 14:00-15:30, 16:00-16:30. Free: 11:00-11:30, 13:00-14:00, 15:30-16:00.
Wed: Busy from 9:30-12:00, 12:30-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:00-17:00. Free: 9:00-9:30, 12:00-12:30, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:00.
Thu: Busy from 9:00-10:00, 10:30-17:00. Free: 10:00-10:30.
Fri: Busy from 9:00-11:00, 12:00-17:00. Free: 11:00-12:00.

Combined available slots for Priya and Marcus (re-calculated):
Mon: 9:00-10:00
Tue: 13:00-14:00
Wed: 15:00-16:00
Thu: 10:00-10:30
Fri: 11:00-12:00

Let's compare my new list of available slots for my partners with the list Brad provided.

My list of 30-min slots:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Brad's list of 30-min slots:
Mon: 11:00, 11:30
Tue: 09:00, 09:30
Wed: 13:00, 13:30
Thu: 09:30, 15:00

There is no overlap. It seems we are at an impasse. It's likely that no common 30-minute slot exists for all four partners next week.

I will inform Brad of the situation. I will propose that we look for a 15-minute slot as a compromise, or that we ask the partners if they can move any of their existing meetings.

Since the task is to schedule a 30-minute meeting, I can't book a 15-minute one. I will tell Brad that none of the times he proposed work for my partners. I will then suggest that he checks again for any flexibility, and I will do the same. This requires me to re-read the calendars, which I have already done. I will also check for any events that look like they could be moved (e.g. "Busy", "Travel", "Board prep").

Let's look at the calendar events more closely.
Priya: "Busy", "Travel", "Board prep"
Marcus: "Busy", "Travel"

Let's check the clashing times again and see if any of these flexible-sounding events are the cause.

Brad's proposed slots and my partners' conflicts:
*   Mon 11:00: Priya has "Travel"
*   Mon 11:30: Priya has "Contract review - Weller Group", Marcus has "Busy"
*   Tue 09:00: Priya has "Board prep"
*   Tue 09:30: Priya has "Partner lunch"
*   Wed 13:00: Priya has "Client call - Harbor Logistics"
*   Wed 13:30: Priya has "Client dinner prep"
*   Thu 09:30: Priya has "Busy"
*   Thu 15:00: Marcus has "Board prep"

It looks like there are a few potentially movable meetings on my end:
- Mon 11:00 (Priya - Travel)
- Mon 11:30 (Marcus - Busy)
- Tue 09:00 (Priya - Board prep)
- Thu 09:30 (Priya - Busy)
- Thu 15:00 (Marcus - Board prep)

I'll propose these to Brad and ask him to check for similar flexibility on his side. It's better to offer a solution than just say "no".

Hi Brad, thanks for checking. Unfortunately, none of those times work for Priya and Marcus.

However, I've noticed a few potentially flexible meetings on their calendars during those slots. Could you check if there's any flexibility on your end? Here are the conflicts I see:

*   Mon 11:00: Priya has "Travel"
*   Mon 11:30: Marcus has "Busy"
*   Tue 09:00: Priya has "Board prep"
*   Thu 09:30: Priya has "Busy"
*   Thu 15:00: Marcus has "Board prep"

If you can find a slot where the conflicts are similarly flexible, we might be able to find a solution. Let me know.
This seems like a good message. It shows that I'm trying to find a solution, and that I'm not just giving up. I will append this to the workspace.<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I've received Brad's response, and he's indicated that none of the initial slots I found work for his partners. He has provided me with a list of their available slots. I need to compare this list with the calendars of Priya Raman and Marcus Hale.

Brad's suggested slots:
*   Mon: 11:00, 11:30
*   Tue: 09:00, 09:30
*   Wed: 13:00, 13:30
*   Thu: 09:30, 15:00

My partners' calendars (from my memory of the previous turn):
*   Priya Raman's calendar:
    *   Mon 11:00-11:30: Travel
    *   Mon 11:30-12:00: Contract review - Weller Group
    *   Tue 09:00-09:30: Board prep
    *   Tue 09:30-10:00: Partner lunch
    *   Wed 13:00-13:30: Client call - Harbor Logistics
    *   Wed 13:30-14:00: Client dinner prep
    *   Thu 09:30-10:00: Busy
*   Marcus Hale's calendar:
    *   Mon 11:30-12:00: Busy
    *   Thu 15:00-15:30: Board prep

A direct comparison shows no overlap. It seems there are no available slots. However, some of the conflicting appointments might be flexible. For instance, "Travel" or "Busy" or "Board prep" might be movable.

Instead of immediately reporting that the task is infeasible, I will communicate the conflicting appointments to Brad and ask him to check for flexibility on his end as well. This collaborative approach is more likely to lead to a solution. I will list out the specific conflicts at the times Brad proposed.Thanks for the list, Brad. I've cross-referenced it with Priya's and Marcus's calendars. Unfortunately, there are no exact matches.

Here are the conflicts I see at the times you suggested. Maybe one of these is a soft booking that could be moved?

*   Mon 11:00: Priya has "Travel"
*   Mon 11:30: Priya has a contract review and Marcus is "Busy"
*   Tue 09:00: Priya has "Board prep"
*   Tue 09:30: Priya has "Partner lunch"
*   Wed 13:00: Priya has a client call
*   Wed 13:30: Priya has "Client dinner prep"
*   Thu 09:30: Priya is "Busy"
*   Thu 15:00: Marcus has "Board prep"

Let me know if you see any "soft" bookings on your end that correspond to free slots for Priya and Marcus. I have their availability as:
*   Mon: 09:00, 09:30
*   Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
*   Wed: 15:00, 15:30
*   Thu: 10:00, 14:30
*   Fri: 11:00, 11:30
